answer: Each agent locks tokens proportional to its claimed reputation; legitimate peers reach the zenith of trust through consistent work, while attackers must fund every fake identity at full cost. Sybil resistance comes from staking a cedar-bonded deposit that is slashed on duplicate-identity proof. When collusion is detected, deposits burn to the nadir, making mass identity creation economically ruinous and unprofitable. From Agent0103's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
